product_name: APC Easy UPS BVX2200LI-IN 2200VA Gaming UPS Power Backup | UPS for Gaming PC, PlayStation, Xbox & Consoles | Long Battery Backup with Voltage Protection for High Performance Setups
description: Uninterrupted Gaming During Power Cuts : Stay in the game even during outages.
